source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) v02 — Listed Building polygons

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for Historic England NHLE List Entry 1306502 (Bridge Inn, Topsham, Exeter). The live Historic England Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer with ListEntry/Name/Grade fields, and its official metadata states that polygon area is populated where the building footprint has been mapped; however the selected exact single-record GeoJSON response could not be retrieved through the available web channel and direct network resolution failed before any feature payload was read. No geometry was inferred or fabricated, so no individual building record was accepted.
